Q: Which branch is searched (active leaf path, root-to-leaf, or all branches), and what happens when the referenced entry is not on that branch? Cite file#Lx-Ly.
A: When the session manager exposes getBranch(), only that branch (the active path) is searched; getEntries() is used only as fallback when getBranch is absent. The session manager is read live at validation time. If the referenced result is not on the active branch, it is not counted and the reference fails with tool_result_unavailable.
Task: Determine how TaskManage resolves tool:Name#n evidence references in completion answers
